title: JI HARMONIZER -- one key plays a microtonally tuned wavetable chord

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Play MIDI or click the keyboard: each key sounds a chord of up to 12 voices (one key at a time).
Turn audio on with the speaker button in the patching view; the fader sets the level.
ratio column: type a ratio (3/2) or cents (701.955c) per scale degree; on picks the degrees used.
temperament: load a preset scale. It reads Custom when the table matches none.
load .scl or drop a 12-note Scala file on the drop zone; period shows its repeat interval.
tonic sets the scale's root key; A4 sets the reference pitch (Hz).
voices, complexity and voicing shape the chord; spacing and inversion add octave copies.
CHORD FEEL: spread = stereo width, detune ct = random detune, timing ms = random stagger.
WAVETABLE ENGINE: bank A/B pick each oscillator's table; wt pos morphs through it.
lfo A/B rate and depth sweep the positions; osc gain A/B mix the two oscillators.
FILTER: cutoff, resonance, filter lfo (A) and vel > filter drive a master lowpass.
ENVELOPE: atk / dec / sus / rel for the whole chord.
SOUNDING PITCHES lists each voice's frequency, interval and nearest 12-TET note.
presets: click a slot to recall, shift-click to store. Slots save with the patch.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: ji-engine.js tunes the scale from the tonic and builds the chord's frequencies and gains.
A 12-channel mc.gen~ plays two morphing wavetable oscillators per voice from buffer~s.
The chord is panned to stereo, shaped by adsr~, then filtered by a gen~ TPT lowpass.
pattrstorage jhpresets stores every setting, including the ratio table and period.
